title: Publish tab: Connect domain on a draft site asks to publish first instead of opening the domain form; Back to draft warns, per connected domain, that its visitors no longer reach the site
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/core/tracy-core/test/site-publish-dom.test.mjs (the real PublishView bundled into jsdom over a fetch double).
S2: Read the exit code and the result of each named test.
expect: On a draft site, pressing [data-action="connect-domain"] opens no form[data-form] and opens a [role="alertdialog"] holding domains.publishFirstTitle and domains.publishFirstBody; no POST go-live is sent by that press.
Pressing [data-confirm="live"] in that dialog sends exactly one POST go-live with body {"op":"live"} and the dialog closes; Cancel closes it and sends nothing.
On a live site, Connect domain still opens form[data-form="domain"].
Back to draft on a live site with a connected domain shows domains.draftStops naming that domain on a [data-line="draft-domain"] line that carries the class tv-domain-note-alert.
evidence: Vincent, 13/10/2026: Connect domain on a draft site should say the site must be published first; Back to draft after a domain is connected should warn that the domain stops working.
fence: The real Publish tab bundle in jsdom over a fetch double. Not exercised: tracy-web's doors, a real browser, the dsh page around the tab.

tests: Connect domain on a draft site asks to publish first
Connect domain on a draft site, Cancel
Connect domain: the Owner of a site with no domain of its own opens a form for one
connecting on a site that is already live is one more publish
